ad:
Rough, bumpy skin on your legs or arms? Swipe on. Leave on. Feel the difference.

The Smooth Stick is a no-mess glycolic acid body exfoliant in a twist-up stick. It gently loosens the dead skin that makes skin look dotted and feel rough, so legs, arms and the back of the neck look and feel visibly smoother.

Why you'll like it

  • Visibly smoother, softer skin with regular use
  • Helps the look of “strawberry legs” and rough, bumpy patches
  • No scrubbing, no sticky hands, no mess: swipe and go
  • Travel-friendly solid stick

Where to use it

  • Thighs and legs, including the dotted look of “strawberry legs”
  • Upper and back of arms
  • Bikini line and underarms, to help prevent the look of ingrown hairs
  • Dry, rough patches on knees and elbows

Make it a routine: buy the 2- or 3-stick pack and The Exfoliating Mitt is free. Acids loosen dead surface skin; the mitt buffs it away.

Key ingredients

  • Glycolic acid (7%): an AHA that loosens dead skin cells
  • Salicylic acid (0.5%): a BHA that helps clear the look of clogged, bumpy pores
  • Shea butter (10%): keeps skin soft while you exfoliate

Size: 18 g solid stick. Pairs well with: The Exfoliating Mitt, once or twice a week.

How to use

  1. On clean, dry skin, swipe 2–3 times over rough areas.
  2. Leave on. Follow with moisturizer if you like.
  3. Start every other evening, then build to daily.
  4. Use sunscreen on treated areas during the day.

Good to know

Not for broken, irritated or freshly shaved skin. A light tingle is normal; stop if irritation occurs. Patch test first. For external use only.

Shipping

Free US shipping. Orders ship in 1–3 business days and arrive in 8–16 business days, with tracking.

60-day smooth-skin guarantee

Use it for 60 days. If you don't love how your skin feels, email us for a full refund. Keep the product.

During our launch, products ship in the manufacturer’s original packaging.
bd:
Watch the dead skin roll away.

A Korean-style viscose exfoliating mitt for a deep, satisfying body buff in the shower. Pairs with The Smooth Stick for visibly smoother skin.

Details

  • 100% viscose fiber, woven to grip dead skin
  • Elastic cuff and hanging loop
  • One size, about 5.5 × 7.9 in (14 × 20 cm), fits most hands
  • Colour: white

Use it for

  • A deep at-home body scrub, 1–2 times a week
  • Smoothing the look of rough, bumpy skin on legs and arms
  • Prepping skin before self-tan, and buffing off faded tan after
  • Helping body lotion and oil sink in better

Get it free: add a 2- or 3-pack of The Smooth Stick and the mitt is on us.

How to use

  1. Soak in warm water for 10 minutes so skin softens.
  2. Wet the mitt and rub in long strokes with light pressure.
  3. Rinse, then moisturize. Use 1–2 times a week.
  4. Rinse the mitt and hang to dry. Replace every 2–3 months.

Skip broken, sunburned or freshly shaved skin.

Shipping

Free US shipping. Orders ship in 1–3 business days and arrive in 8–16 business days, with tracking.

60-day smooth-skin guarantee

Use it for 60 days. If you don't love how your skin feels, email us for a full refund. Keep the product.

During our launch, products ship in the manufacturer’s original packaging.
cd:
Soft heels, no greasy hands.

A twist-up balm with urea and salicylic acid that softens thick, rough, dry skin on heels, elbows, knees and hands. Swipe on at night, slip on socks, and let it work while you sleep.

Key ingredients

  • Urea (60%): softens thick, rough skin and holds in moisture
  • Salicylic acid (2%): helps loosen dry, flaky buildup
  • Shea butter, tea tree oil, vitamin E: keep skin soft and comfortable

Size: 40 g / 1.4 oz twist-up stick.

Use it for

  • Dry, rough heels and the edges of your soles
  • Rough elbows and knees
  • Dry, chapped-feeling hands in winter
  • Quick touch-ups on the go: mess-free and bag-friendly

How to use

  1. Swipe onto clean, dry heels, elbows, knees or hands at night.
  2. Wear socks for best results.
  3. Use nightly until smooth, then 2–3 times a week.

For heels, elbows, knees and hands. Not for face or broken skin.

Shipping

Free US shipping. Orders ship in 1–3 business days and arrive in 8–16 business days, with tracking.

60-day smooth-skin guarantee

Use it for 60 days. If you don't love how your skin feels, email us for a full refund. Keep the product.
